raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator directed WebSurfer to download the World Bank indicator NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS (Gross domestic savings % of GDP) instead of the required Gross savings (% of GDP) dataset (e.g., NY.GNS.ICTR.ZS). Using the wrong indicator led to analyzing the wrong metric and producing an incorrect country list; this also compounded with not filtering out non-country aggregates and non-standard names.
